profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer/Lead/Architect | USN Veteran
profile.summary:
TECHNICAL EXPERTISE
Design and Architecture with Azure Cloud, Embedded, System Integrations, Salesforce Apex
Development Software: Visual Studio 2022 and Visual Studio Code;
Software Technology: MVC 5 & MVC 6, ASP.NET, .NET 9, Micro/nano services
Database Technologies: SQL Server 2000-2016, OpenAI SDK, Grok
Languages: C# (including C# 12); Python, C++, Javascript 
Other: Xamarin and Mono

Volunteer-
* First Robotics mentor at Mission Hills High School
* (Founded) First Lego League (FLL) teams at Mission Hills Church
* Served as San Marcos EOC during 2007 wildfires

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Communication · Code Review · Git · User Stories · HTML

company.name: Forest Lawn Memorial Parks and Mortuaries

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Analyst
positions.description:
“Managed The Lounge and Customer Service Portal to replace Owners Lounge” 
- Manage and lead technical aspects of near offshore team of developers
- Create stories/bugs, set priorities, met with business stakeholders, manage timeline with project managers, met with marketing for campaign and UI/UX designers and project managers
- Meet with IT security departments to implement Veracode code scanning and site scanning
- Architected and designed web applications to be used by external customers and internal owner service agents
- Provisioned Azure resources for production build that included private interfaces that implemented VNETs
- Managed Azure, DevOps, and Okta platforms

“Created platform data analyzation tool”
- Architected, designed, and coded Blazer server-side app that was platform and data agnostic using C# .NET 6 beta, EF 6, Blazor and PostgreSQL, which allows for quick querying and comparison of data from multiple platforms (SQL server, REST API, Salesforce streaming API)
positions.insights: Skills: Communication · Code Review · Git · User Stories · HTML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently architecting B2C solutions in Azure for project while leading team of developers that include integrating decoupled/headless Drupal with Okta (for authentication and authorization) and microservices to integrate, cache and consolidate response data. 
Microservices and nano services such as Azure Functions and decoupled resources allowing flexibility and reuse.
Technologies include ASP.NET Core 3, JavaScript, SQL Server, NoSQL, OpenID Connect as well as other Azure resources.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Project analyst and developer for high volume mail list organization, presort, and reporting desktop client-server application. Developed and maintained other web services, apps and Window's applications used for integrating managing customers, referrals and automating mail piece services.
Technology used:
Visual Studio 2008, C# .NET 3.5, 2.0 and sometimes 1.1, LINQ,  and Visual FoxPro

Application Types: 
ASP.NET web applications, web services, Windows services, windows applications.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: I was the main Visual FoxPro programmer for company's foreclosure scheduling and contact manager software product used by law firms across the country. I also wrote the company’s only .NET web application and web services that worked in conjunction the Visual FoxPro SOAP client that could upload up to 100MB worth of files using token streaming.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
-	Helped develop and maintain the company’s premier software used to print invoices, payroll, etc.
-	Developed checkbook-printing software for the banking industry.
-	Developed extended tabs on print drivers using Hewlett Packard’s print driver extension kit to inject print streams that communicate with custom embedded software on the printer to extend printer functionality.
-	Developed an archive and reprint package allowing high-level application access and management to a low-level print stream manipulation objects.
-	Created custom tabs on the print dialog screen for using a kit to extend print driver capabilities.
-	Helped develop a Palm OS application to control HP printer settings using the IR capabilities of a Palm Pilot.
-	Created dozens of custom data filters to create reliably formatted data text files of all types for reliable parsing.
-	Developed a web based print server to merge data and form templates producing printer PCL code and stream to a printer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer that worked on a PLC controlled robotic assembly line. Designed and developed PLC software for pneumatic elevators, servo software for an X-Y gantry for spreading painting reagent chemicals on the product, and pump software for expelling the reagent at the appropriate time. Also developed software written in C++ for a PC controlled a multi-use chemical dispenser.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Application developer, database administrator and wrote various utilities icluding a serial terminal emmulator for the PC, using Visual FoxPro, Borland C, FoxPro for UNIX, CShell scripts, and Business Basic on a mini-computer and PC.
Wrote applications that supported accounting, loan servicing, marketing, and various other departments.

positions.description: Fix and maintain shipboard radio equipment
